entry.title: Conversion Is a Property of System Design, Not Marketing
entry.summary: When conversion drops, marketing is usually blamed first. As an engineer, I learned that this framing is often wrong. Conversion is not primarily a marketing metric. system-level property. Marketing brings users to the system. A user does not leave because the CTA color was wrong. At every step, the user silently asks: Do I understand what is happening? Do I trust this? Is this safe? What happens if I make a mistake? If the system fails to answer any of these questions, conversion drops. Conversion is not a funnel. It is a chain of micro-decisions: I click the link. I see the screen. I understand the request. entry.title: Day-23 🐳 Dockerizing a 3-Tier MERN App & Diving into ITSM Tools
entry.summary: Today was a massive step forward in my DevOps journey. ServiceNow: Specifically regarding Incident Management (handling outages) and Change Management (safely deploying updates). Understanding how these tools fit into the CI/CD pipeline is crucial for working in enterprise environments. 🚀 What's Next? https://www.linkedin.com/in/dasari-jayanth-b32ab9367/
